analysis.narrativeEn:

· High position relative to SMA100($1,882.33)/SMA200($2,016.36): Maintaining mid-to-long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (30.7%) + Historically recovered from lows, currently in an upward phase.

· RSI 78.1 → 77.4 (staying overbought): Overbought condition persists, potential for short-term cooling.
· MACD histogram 63.3630 → 42.7178 (improving): Bullish momentum sustained, suggesting room for further upside.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near upper band $2,689.82): Approaching upper band, caution for overheating.
[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Swing Resistance ($2,520.41): Breakout expected to fuel further upside.

[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.93): Normal level, moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Uptrend): Entered short-term overbought territory, look for pullback buying opportunities on further gains.
